title: HyperGraSS / EIMDL: Four-Generation Evolutionary Lossless Genomic Compressor (.hgs2/.hgs3), Native C23/C++23/Rust Engine, and Compressed-Domain Genomics
description: Open-source lossless genomic, reference-conditioned, and pangenome compression engine uniting seven algebraic-biological laws (Klein V4 substitution coding, bijective mod-3 codon-wobble gaps, 6-state causal ORF HMM, two-gear coalescent haplotype copying + affine micro-indels, subsampled CSR syncmer indexing, two-adic Pitman-Yor FastCRM, and disjoint Stage-1/2 -Xmx128m heap scaling) with Next-Gen .hgs3 multi-omic FASTQ+CDS containers, wire-compatible Native C23/C++23/Rust 2024 + Java 25 LTS execution, and zero-FASTA compressed-domain analytics (analyze, VCF v4.2 variants, lazy k-mer search, and slice queries).
